name: mc_render
title: Render view
description:
Renders a region as a PNG image from a chosen viewpoint, so an AI can see terrain layout and building results instead of reading block-state text. Views include existing maps/facades/slices/heightmaps and shape-aware isometric/perspective schematics.

WHEN TO USE: isometric/perspective for one finished-build appearance check showing stairs, slabs, doors, windows and depth. "top" to check terrain shape, a build's footprint, or how a structure sits on the land. "north"/"south"/"east"/"west" to inspect a facade - windows, doors, symmetry, roof lines. "slice" (axis + coordinate) for a floor plan (axis "y") or a vertical cut, e.g. to confirm a room is hollow. "heightmap" for terrain relief; prefer mc_survey, which adds the exact numbers.

WHEN NOT TO USE: to get exact block states, orientations or counts - use mc_inspect. Colors are lossy, not textures. Angled views list approximate/cube-fallback models; not an exhaustive vanilla renderer.

PARAMETERS: `from`/`to` are inclusive corners in any order: [x,y,z], or [x,z] for "top"/"heightmap" (preferred - the surface is found automatically; pass a y range to a top view only to look under a roof or underground, since it shows the highest block within that range). "top"/"heightmap" are area-priced (x/z footprint <= 200,000 cells); side/angled views/"slice" are volume-priced (<= 200,000 blocks) - for a facade, limit y to the building's height. `view` (default "top") is one of top/north/south/east/west/slice/heightmap/isometric/perspective; `slice` is required for `view: "slice"`. `scale` is pixels per block, 0-16 (default 0 = auto). `grid` is grid spacing, 0-64 (default 10; 0 disables it). `camera` for angled views: compass azimuth 0-360, elevation 5-85, perspective fov 20-90. Angled grids must be 0. `heightmapType`/`contour` are heightmap-only.

SIDE EFFECTS: none - read-only. Returns an image plus text: view, axes, top-left coordinate, grid interval and a legend (blocks as hex color, name, pixel count; for "heightmap", height bands plus min/max/median height, surface materials and the largest flat zone). PNGs are capped at 3MB (scale halves automatically).

world.description: World name. Omitted uses the plugin's configured default world.

from.description: Inclusive corner of the region: [x, y, z], or just [x, z] for view "top"/"heightmap" (the surface is then found automatically over the whole world height). Give a y range to a top view only when you want to look under a roof or underground.

to.description: Inclusive corner opposite `from`, same shape as `from`. Order does not matter.

view.description: "top" (default): top-down layout, shaded like a vanilla in-game map. "north"/"south"/"east"/"west": the facade seen from that compass direction, shaded by depth. "slice": an exact-color 2D cross-section (requires the `slice` parameter). "heightmap": color-banded terrain. "isometric" (orthographic) / "perspective": shape-aware schematic depth with optional camera; require 3D bounds and are volume-priced.

axis.description: Which axis is held fixed. "y" gives a top-down floor plan at one exact layer; "x" or "z" gives a vertical cross-section.

at.description: The fixed coordinate value on that axis. Must lie within [from, to] on that axis.

scale.description: Pixels per block, 0-16. Default 0 = auto-sized so the image's longer side is about 1024px (flat views capped at 4,000,000 pixels). Angled views cap 1,000,000 pixels plus estimated intersection work, adapting resolution explicitly.

grid.description: Draw a coordinate grid line every N blocks, with coordinate labels along the top/left edges. Default 10 for flat views; angled views default to 0 and reject nonzero grids.

camera.description: Angled views only. Compass azimuth (north=0, east=90), default 135. Elevation defaults 35.26438968 for isometric and 30 for perspective. Perspective fov defaults 50, invalid on isometric. Work budgets can reduce resolution, reported explicitly.

heightmapType.description: Only used when `view` is "heightmap": which surface to measure (same meaning as mc_survey's `type`). Default SOLID_OR_LIQUID_NO_LEAVES.

contour.description: Only used when `view` is "heightmap": draw a contour line every N blocks of height, 0 disables. Default 5.
